preconditions.description: The number of data centers n is between 2 and 100,000.
The number of clients m is between 1 and 100,000.
The day length h is between 2 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of data centers k that have to be included in an experiment is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in x1, x2, ..., xk)
postconditions.description: The indices of data centers to be included in the experiment are all between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(ci,1 != ci,2 for each client i)
postconditions.description: For each client, the two data centers storing their data are different.

postconditions.expression: all(uj < h for uj in u1, u2, ..., un)
postconditions.description: The maintenance hour for each data center is less than the day length h.

postconditions.expression: all(all(ci,1 != ci,2 for each client i) and all(uj < h for uj in u1, u2, ..., un))
postconditions.description: The input data satisfies all the given conditions.
